claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Midodrine, a prodrug of the alpha-1 adrenergic agonist desglymidodrine, is unlikely to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect adrenergic receptor-mediated signaling or a nonspecific physicochemical effect rather than a potent cytotoxic mechanism.
